text:
andrew: Heads-up: staging perf run after the latest flash-fusion kernels shows ~12% median decode latency regression for small-batch (N<=4) decodes. Repro and traces: https://perf.redwood/internal/trace/1955554321  cc @mia @raj

perfbot: benchmark-run 1955: small-batch decode median 42.8ms -> baseline 38.1ms (+12.28%). Prefill median unchanged. GPU/CPU timeline attached.
```
metric,baseline,current,delta
decode_median_ms,38.1,42.8,+12.28%
prefill_median_ms,95.4,95.9,+0.5%
gpu_util,68%,72%,+4%
```

mia: Thanks. Any flame graphs? Is KV cache hit pattern different during small-batch decode?

andrew: Flamegraph here: https://perf.redwood/internal/flame/1955. Quick observation: extra cuda memcpy calls appear in the decode path around a kvpage fallback check. Paging heuristics look like they're firing with small headroom after fusion change.

raj: I ran a targeted microbench: kernel selector flips to flash-fused for prefill but for decode when seq_len < 32 and batch < 4 it sometimes runs the paged attention fallback. Suspect new index packing in fusion changed padding/alignment thresholds.

tim: Can we force fused kernel for decode-only to validate? Quick toggle: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_FORCE=fused decode_bench --batch 2 --seq 16` — I'll run it.

tim: run results: forced fused -> decode median 39.2ms (baseline 38.1ms, current 42.8ms). Forcing fused reduces regression from +12% to +2.9%, so fallback path adds ~3.6ms.
```
# decode_bench output snippet
batch=2 seq=16
baseline_median=38.1ms
forced_fused_median=39.2ms
staging_current_median=42.8ms
```

mia: If forcing fused helps, we can either tighten fallback thresholds or skip paging for small-batch decode when kv hit-rate is high. Need to be careful for long-seq prefill where memory spikes matter.

zoe: Ran KV profiler on the failing trace: KV cache hit ratio ~98% for small-batch decode, but the page-check codepath still runs and costs ~600us per token in checks. Looks like an extra branch/check introduced by the batching change.
```
# simplified profiler print
step,kv_hits,kv_checks,check_cost_us
decode_step_10,98,102,600
decode_step_11,99,103,610
```

andrew: Good catch. Proposed patch: skip page-check pipeline when cache_hit_rate > 0.95 AND batch_size <= 4. I'll draft a tiny diff for runtime selector. :thumbsup:

raj: Also add a metric tag 'kernel_fallback_reason' (values: alignment/paging/memory) so future spikes are traceable. We should surface that in per-route dashboards.

perfbot: scheduled A/B run with the patch on canary nodes for 6h. Expected delta reported hourly. A/B link: https://perf.redwood/internal/ab/1955 :rocket:

andrew: Thanks all — I'll open the RFC and assign reviewers @mia @raj. If canary looks good we roll to staging then prod.
